posts.title: What makes a puzzle hard? Grading puzzles for my first iOS game
posts.description: After spending about a month building Furdoku, my first iOS game, I came to a conclusion that didn’t surprise me at all: building is never the hardest part. The hardest part is actually making it a product, which involves a range of challenges from design to sales and marketing. Most of my time went into the game design.
